rows.grounds: ablative of cause indicating ignorance as motive
ablative of cause indicating greed as motive
compound denoting the act of giving a mantra
present action of performing the giving

items.question: What improper motives can lead someone to perform mantra transmission?
premises: Mantra-giving is the action under consideration.
items.inference: Mantra-giving may be performed out of ignorance or out of greed.
uncertainties: The consequence of such mantra-giving is not stated in this verse and depends on context.
items.plain_english: And if someone gives a mantra out of ignorance or out of greed.
